question: Can a prequential out-of-model alarm and conservative action fallback reduce false confidence on unknown 3-parent/random outcomes while preserving known 2-parent intervention benefit?
hypothesis: Guarded active outperforms balanced on true 2-parent held Brier by >=0.010 and positive paired 95% CI, degrades vs unguarded active <=0.008, and on parity3 and random OOD has Brier no worse than best balanced/random +0.015 and improves on unguarded active >=0.015 each. Exact continuation restores pass.

data.held_labels: 32 possible actions, deterministic disjoint held-out noise domain, shared outcomes across arms, never updated into any learner
data.worlds: Two-parent source = one of 10 non-unary Boolean functions of a sampled pair; unary copy/invert; 3-parent parity and independent fair random are not represented by learner grammar; 5% noise on deterministic sources.

arms.guarded: Original 113-hypothesis Bayesian posterior; use balanced probe at zero-index training steps 3,7,11, otherwise entropy-max action unless alarm active, then balanced. Record prequential surprise when probability assigned to observed label < exp(-0.85); sticky alarm if >=3 surprises in latest six observations once six seen. If alarm, post-training predictions shrunk 50% toward 0.5.
arms.active: Original Gate13 entropy-max action and posterior forecast, no probes or defensive shrinkage.
arms.balanced: Original Gate13 deterministic (11*step+seed%32+13*context)%32 action schedule; same posterior.
arms.random: Original Gate13 independent deterministic seeded random action; same posterior.
arms.damped_active: Original Gate13 entropy-max action; held predictions always 0.8*p_model+0.2*0.5; isolates constant shrinkage effect.

budget.posterior: Exactly same fixed 113 hypotheses and prior as Gate13: 3 order-zero p=.05,.5,.95, 10 unary, 100 genuinely two-parent Boolean, equal prior mass by model order. Assumes 5% label noise on deterministic sources.
budget.information: All policies choose only their own 12 intervention consequences; same deterministic action/visit keyed noisy response function and common held labels. No teacher or private true operator or parent leaks.
budget.candidate_work: Every policy computes posterior for all 32 candidate interventions at every action and updates all 113 posterior terms. This intentionally equalizes counted work; balanced/random could operate far cheaper in practice. No compute or energy advantage claim.
budget.checkpoint: Two contexts each: 113 float64 scores +32 uint8 visit counts +1 uint8 step +6 uint8 ring surprises +1 uint8 ring index +1 uint8 seen count +1 uint8 alarm = 946 bytes/context, 1892 total. All arms allocate same size.
budget.cold: After A then B, verify A unchanged; pack and independently restore twice, continue four A interventions with identical chosen actions, outcomes, packed state and predictions on every step; same-process synthetic continuation only.

method.entropy: Choose maximum Bernoulli posterior predictive entropy; tie at 1e-12 resolved by fewest visits then lowest x. This is not generally identical to mutual information under a nonhomogeneous null hypothesis.
method.probes: Balanced interventions on steps [3,7,11] for guarded only
method.alert: After each observed response, store whether assigned posterior predictive probability to actual response is below exp(-0.85), ring length 6. After at least six samples, sticky alarm when >=3 recent surprises; no hidden data used.
method.fallback: When alarm set, choose balanced instead of entropy for non-probe actions; at held evaluation predict 0.5*p_model+0.25.
method.eval: Held Brier score mean over 2 worlds per seed; seeded paired 95% normal confidence intervals per family; lower is better.

classification: All thresholds must pass for development-only guarded action finding. One failure is MIXED/NO_GO. No native Yggdrasil first-use, self-assembling topology, full-process compute advantage or scientific acceptance can be inferred.
source_sequence: Commit prereg then source before primary data; seal results before adding audit or CI; never tune thresholds on observed seeds.
